I dispute the $685 damage balance stated in your January 1, 2028 notice concerning our former Park Slope tenancy.

At the October 2024 post-handoff accounting, management confirmed that the full security deposit was returned, no cleaning, repair, damage, utility, key, or occupancy deductions were taken, and the former tenancy had a zero balance with no remaining condition claim. We returned possession and all keys on September 30, 2024, after the walkthrough.

Please withdraw this charge and confirm in writing that the account remains at $0 and that no collection or credit reporting action will be taken. If you contend the charge is still valid, send the complete itemized basis for it, including the inspection records, dated photographs, invoices or estimates, and the lease provision you rely on. Please also preserve all records related to the claim while it is disputed.

This dispute is not an acknowledgment of liability. Thank you,
Alex Valdez
